description: This file defines a Retrofit API interface for accessing category-based endpoints in a TV-related Android application. It includes network configuration, a method to fetch category items, and documentation comments.

classes.name: ApiService
classes.description: Retrofit API interface for fetching categorized content items from a network endpoint.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Suspend function that retrieves a list of ContentItem objects for a specified category path.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Builds and returns a singleton instance of ApiService configured with network and JSON parsing settings.
